value.string: source, args_json=\'[]\', component_reference=None, function=\'run\', keep=False, kwargs_json=\'{}\'

Run trusted (unrestricted) Python on the instance in one call.
 
 ⚠ DESTRUCTIVE: like erp5_skin_call but the code runs TRUSTED — no sandbox, it
 can use os/open/subprocess, private attributes, production APIs. Treat like a
 shell tool on the server.
 
 The payload is deployed as a temporary Extension Component (reference
 MCPTrustedExec_<sha256[:8] of source> — identical sources reuse the same
 component, so re-runs are idempotent), wired as an External Method into
 portal_skins/custom (id ZZ_trusted_exec_<digest>), the chosen module-level
 function is invoked, and — unless keep=true — both temp artifacts are deleted
 again in the same transaction. Write the function's first parameter as `self`:
 called without positional args it receives the ERP5 site (Zope's External
 Method self-injection). Function result: JSON-serialisable values pass
 through, everything else is repr'd.
 
 This replaces the manual trusted bootstrap (temp component + manage_addExternalMethod
 skin script + cleanup) that every trusted task used to need.
 
 On failure the request transaction is aborted (transaction_aborted: true):
 nothing the function did is persisted and no temp artifact is left behind —
 error ⇒ nothing persisted.
 
 args_json / kwargs_json are JSON strings for the 2nd+ parameters (self is
 injected). keep=true returns kept ids: {component_id, external_method_id}.
